description: Source code for CameraController actor managing camera and microphone access, photo and video capture, device listing, and media processing in an iOS app.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Delegate for handling photo capture callbacks, managing continuation for asynchronous photo data retrieval.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Delegate for handling movie recording callbacks, managing continuation for asynchronous URL retrieval.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo with specified parameters, returns format, base64-encoded image, width, and height.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip with optional audio, transcodes to MP4, returns format, base64-encoded video, duration, and audio presence.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists available camera devices with their info.

methods.name: ensureAccess
methods.description: Checks and requests camera or microphone access permissions.

methods.name: pickCamera
methods.description: Selects an AVCaptureDevice based on facing and device ID.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for camera device position.

methods.name: clampDurationMs
methods.description: Clamps duration in milliseconds between 250 and 60000.

methods.name: exportToMP4
methods.description: Exports a video from MOV to MP4 format asynchronously.

methods.name: sleepDelayMs
methods.description: Asynchronously delays execution for specified milliseconds.
